purpose: Make the single accumulative incremental candidate a physical machine-enforced authority rather than a rule distributed across block locks and guard status enums.

rootCause.summary: The project required one accumulative candidate, but physical product composition authorization was distributed across Control Plane, B1/B2 locks, historical successor scopes and hardcoded status lists in the guard/workflow. A legitimate new remediation state could therefore make the guard ignore already-authorized product owners and report false source drift. This also made preservation of prior improvements dependent on multiple consumers staying manually synchronized.

demonstratedFailure.head: 577d455c618fa15614865f4f53832f79f00a210b
demonstratedFailure.discriminant: B2 lock authorized the causal owners, but guard b2Active did not recognize status OPEN_PAULA_VISUAL_REJECTED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED, so the B2 allowed set was omitted.
demonstratedFailure.effect: The current cumulative source could not be certified even though the causal B2 owners were already physically authorized.

definitiveSolution.updateRule: Any product-source change must update this composition lock in the same atomic commit; otherwise the central guard fails closed before build/Preview.
definitiveSolution.noPreauthorization: A path may not remain in the composition manifest if it does not physically differ from the certified baseline.
definitiveSolution.noSilentOmission: Every physical product path that differs from the certified baseline must exist in this manifest.
definitiveSolution.blobBinding: Every listed path is bound to its current Git blob SHA.
definitiveSolution.statusLabelIndependence: Composition authorization does not depend on duplicated display/workflow status enums.
definitiveSolution.preservation: Prior accepted B1 improvements and all B2 causal fixes remain in one tree; no historical module package or overlay can replace the accumulated tree.

lastRemediation.rootCause: Global Cobros receipt detail has no c360-body, so R9 local-body optimization cannot apply and fallback still rebuilt Cliente360 on demand.
lastRemediation.fix: Idle-prefetch Cliente360 summary while receipt detail is open, consume one-shot summary on back, prevent hash routing, update URL with history.replaceState.

lastMechanismRootFix.cause: The R8 composition lock was labeled B3-004 while the central guard activates canonical composition only when composition.currentBlock equals Control Plane currentBlock B3. Separately, the B3-004 contract retained one R6 native-receipt cache-key assertion after the R8 cache bump.
lastMechanismRootFix.fix: Restore composition currentBlock to B3 with activeFindingId B3-004, and update only the stale QA assertion to the R8 asset key.

concurrentSourceReconciliation.reason: Product source changed after B3-003 artifact build; immutable release rules require a new exact artifact/digest.
concurrentSourceReconciliation.guardClassificationNote: Current guard treats every changed path outside approved Gravicentra governance prefixes as canonical composition diff; the CotComp QA workflow and test therefore must be bound alongside the owner source.

compositionSetRepair.cause: R5 causally modified portal-v1142-copyfix.js, which was not previously in the certified changed-product set.
compositionSetRepair.fix: Add the newly changed product owner to the exact product set and bind its exact blob.

blockers.evidence: Human direct receipt link did not open the exact receipt; user had to locate the synthetic client/receipt manually.
Human mobile observation: entering Cobros took approximately 7–10 seconds, despite desktop warm-browser machine metric of 138 ms.
Applying payment took approximately 10 seconds and the UI did not visibly indicate that save/upload/persistence was in progress.
Reconciliation modal was not mobile responsive; save control was not reachable/visible in the human viewport.
Receipt detail showed payment support as 'Adjunto' but exposed no visible open/view/download action for the durable document.
Receipt action area overflowed/clipped on mobile, including the long payment-evidence edit-lock action.
